title: ProbeBench: p95/p99 probe harness + storyboards for route/model/region
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a lightweight, reproducible harness (ProbeBench) that can inject controlled token/sec load, replay real request traces, and emit p95/p99 latency signals segmented by route, model, and region. Deliver an exploratory 'storyboard' dashboard for ops and SREs that ties quantile shifts to likely root causes (prompt length, cache hit rate, streaming vs non-streaming, function calls). The goal is faster regression detection and clearer triage workflows without adding high telemetry overhead in production.
acceptance_criteria: ProbeBench can run synthetic and replay workloads and generate p95/p99 time series per route/model/region
Dashboard storyboards display top 3 correlated features for any quantile shift (prompt length quartiles, kv-cache hit fraction, tokens/sec buckets)
Regression job triggers an alert when p95 increases >20% or p99 >25% for 10 minutes on a route-model-region slice
End-to-end run completes within resource budgets on dedicated dev GPUs and publishes artifact links (CSV, jsonlines)
implementation_notes: Leverage existing percentile-telemetry pipeline for ingestion; add ProbeBench marker tag to traffic for easy filtering
Implement dynamic KV cache priming sequences to reproduce cold/warm cache scenarios
Use Dockerized harness that supports line-rate token/sec ramp-up and programmable arrival patterns (poisson, burst, steady)
Emit lightweight diagnostics: queue_time_ms, service_time_ms, tokens_per_req, kv_cache_hit_rate, gpu_util_percent
plan: Spike (2d): prototype probe runner that streams requests and captures latency histograms per slice
Design (1d): storyboard layout and correlation heuristics; pick statistical tests (KS or Spearman) for feature attribution
Implement (5d): runner + exporter + ingestion flags to percentile pipeline
Dashboards (3d): build storyboard views in Console with drift annotation and quick links to PR/commit history
Rollout (2d): smoke runs on staging routes, iterate on false positive tuning, then enable Canary monitoring for prod routes
